title: Collision cover
text: Accidental collision damage is covered, subject to the deductible and policy conditions.

title: Flood exclusion
text: Flood damage is excluded from this standard policy, including flood damage following a collision.

title: Theft cover
text: Theft of the insured vehicle is covered, subject to a police report and policy conditions.

title: Wear exclusion
text: Damage caused by normal wear and tear or aging components is excluded.

title: Commercial use exclusion
text: Commercial use, including rideshare and paid delivery, is excluded even when collision damage occurs.

title: Fire cover
text: Accidental fire damage is covered, subject to investigation and policy conditions.

title: Glass cover
text: Accidental windshield or glass damage is covered, subject to the glass deductible.
